title: cobolwork reachability extract
description: Who may start each transaction and job, and which run with elevated authority, reduced from a RACF unload and the SIT and brought as COBOLWORK_REACH. docs/spec/reach.md. lib/reach.mjs reads it; a key it does not read is reported under summary.feedWarnings, and a key opening with an underscore is a note for people.

version.description: The extract version. An extract without one is read as version 0, which holds the same keys as version 1.

privileged.description: The transactions and jobs that run with elevated authority.
